contentEn:
Replacing a gas furnace with a heat pump cuts heating costs in half while adding air conditioning for Metro Vancouver summers. BC Hydro offers rebates up to $10,000 for qualifying installations, and Reno Stars handles the full process from equipment selection through permit and rebate application.

How a Heat Pump Works in BC Winters

A heat pump moves heat rather than creating it, like a refrigerator in reverse. Modern cold-climate units extract warmth from outside air even at -10°C. One unit replaces both furnace and air conditioner — for a typical 2,000 sq ft Vancouver home, a properly sized heat pump heats and cools the entire space. Reno Stars installs Mitsubishi, Daikin and Carrier — proven in Lower Mainland conditions.

Heat Pump Installation Cost in BC 2026

Installed costs for a complete system range $12,000–$20,000 before rebates, depending on home size and ducted vs. ductless choice. BC Hydro rebates cover a significant portion — the amount depends on the HSPF rating and whether you are replacing electric baseboard, gas or oil. Switching from gas or oil typically qualifies for the largest incentives.

BC Hydro Rebates: What You Get

The NextGen Cooling Incentive offers $2,000–$10,000 for qualifying heat pump installations. The heat pump must be on the BC Hydro approved product list and installed by a licensed contractor. Rebates are paid directly to the contractor and deducted from your invoice — you do not pay full price upfront and wait for reimbursement. Reno Stars includes free rebate application handling with every installation quote. Federal Canada Green Homes loans provide up to $40,000 in low-interest financing, and Clean BC Better Homes may add further incentives.

Do You Need a Permit for a Heat Pump in BC?

Yes. Heat pump installations involving electrical work require an electrical permit, and if new refrigerant lines are run through walls or floors, a refrigeration permit is also required. For most Lower Mainland single-family homes, permits take 5–10 business days to issue. Reno Stars obtains all required permits as part of every installation — no paperwork left to the homeowner.

Reno Stars Heat Pump Installation Services

Reno Stars has installed heat pumps in Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Surrey and surrounding communities. We handle the full scope: equipment recommendation based on your home's size and insulation profile, permit applications, removal of old furnace or baseboards, new equipment installation, and BC Hydro rebate submission. Each installation includes a full walkthrough of the new system and its operating modes. Wi-Fi thermostats compatible with most heat pump brands are also available.

Frequently Asked Questions

Will a heat pump work efficiently in a cold Vancouver winter?

Modern cold-climate heat pumps maintain heating output down to -15°C to -20°C. A correctly sized unit heats your Lower Mainland home throughout every winter without dropping below your thermostat setting. Mitsubishi Zubadan and Daikin Altazur are designed specifically for Canadian cold-climate performance.

How long does heat pump installation take?

A complete single-family home installation typically takes 2–3 days: Day 1 for removing the old system and installing new equipment, Day 2 for electrical connections, thermostat wiring and system commissioning. Permits usually require 5–10 business days to issue before work begins.

Does a heat pump increase home value?

Yes. Industry cost-value reports for the Vancouver area indicate heat pump installations typically recover 80–100% of their cost at resale. Energy-efficient heating appeals strongly to buyers who understand the savings on gas or oil operating costs.

Can I install a heat pump without ductwork?

Yes. Multi-zone ductless (mini-split) heat pump systems deliver heating and cooling to individual rooms through wall-mounted units connected to an outdoor compressor. This is often the best choice for older Vancouver homes, townhouses and apartments without central ductwork. Reno Stars installs both ducted and ductless systems.

Ready to install a heat pump in the Lower Mainland? Contact Reno Stars for a free heat pump quote.

用熱泵替換燃氣鍋爐可將家庭供暖費用減半，同時為弗雷澤河下游地區的夏季提供冷氣制冷。BC水電局目前為符合條件的熱泵安裝提供高達$10,000的補貼——Reno Stars負責從設備選型到許可申請的全部流程。

熱泵如何在BC冬季運作

熱泵不是產生熱量，而是轉移熱量，原理與冰箱相反。即使室外溫度降至-10°C，現代低溫氣候熱泵仍能從室外空氣中提取足夠的熱量為您的房屋供暖。系統會在最寒冷的日子自動切換至電阻備用供暖，確保您永遠不會失去舒適感。一台設備同時取代您的爐子和冷氣機——對於典型2,000平方英尺的溫哥華住宅，適當規格的熱泵可為整個房屋供暖和制冷。Reno Stars安裝三菱、大金和開利品牌的熱泵——這些品牌在下游氣候條件下性能已獲驗證。

2026年BC熱泵安裝費用

補貼前，全套熱泵系統的安裝費用通常在$12,000至$20,000之間，具體取決於房屋面積及管道或無管道系統的選擇。BC水電局的補貼可抵消大部分費用——金額取決於HSPF供暖能效等級以及您是在替換電底板、燃氣爐還是燃油系統。從燃氣或燃油更換的用戶通常有資格獲得最大激勵。

BC水電局補貼：您能獲得多少

下一代制冷激勵計劃為熱泵安裝提供$2,000至$10,000的補貼。熱泵必須在BC水電局批准產品清單上，並由持牌承包商安裝。補貼直接支付給承包商並從發票中扣除——您無需先支付全款再等待報銷。Reno Stars在每項熱泵安裝報價中均包含免費補貼申請處理服務。聯邦加拿大綠色住房貸款提供高達$40,000的低息融資，Clean BC Better Homes計劃可提供額外補充激勵。

BC熱泵安裝是否需要許可

需要。涉及電氣工作的熱泵安裝需要電氣許可；如果安裝包括穿牆或地板的新制冷劑管路，還需要制冷許可。對於下游大多數單戶住宅，許可流程需要5至10個工作日。Reno Stars作為標準安裝服務的一部分獲取所有必要許可。

Reno Stars的熱泵安裝服務

Reno Stars已在溫哥華、列治文、本拿比、科奎爾特蘭、薩里及周邊社區的住宅中安裝了熱泵。我們處理全部工作範圍：設備推薦、許可申請、舊爐子拆除、新設備安裝及BC水電局補貼提交。每項安裝均包括新系統的完整解說及運行模式說明。

常見問題

熱泵能在寒冷的溫哥華冬季高效運作嗎？

現代低溫氣候熱泵在低至-15°C至-20°C的溫度下仍能保持供暖輸出。三菱Zubadan和大金Altazur專為加拿大低溫氣候性能而設計。

熱泵安裝需要多長時間？

單戶住宅的完整安裝通常需要2至3天，許可在工作開始前需要5至10個工作日發放。

熱泵會增加房屋價值嗎？

是的。熱泵安裝通常可回收成本的80%至100%。

如果我的房屋沒有管道系統，我可以安裝熱泵嗎？

可以。多區域無管道（分體式）熱泵系統通常是沒有中央管道的老房子、聯排別墅和公寓的最佳選擇。Reno Stars同時安裝管道和無管道系統。

想在下游地區安裝熱泵？聯繫Reno Stars獲取免費熱泵報價。
